fieldGuidance.subtitle: Short tagline shown under the app name. Punchy and concrete, not a literal translation of the English. Say what the app is for — checklists you reuse, reset, and run again. Title-case or sentence-case per local convention.
fieldGuidance.promotional_text: Short promotional banner (editable without shipping a new version). Lead with the most compelling current hook.
fieldGuidance.keywords: Comma-separated search terms, not a translation; follow the Keywords section. Fill as much of the byte budget as natural terms allow, and no more.
fieldGuidance.description: Full listing description. Transcreate into natural, native marketing prose — adapt idiom and flow, do not calque the English. Preserve the overall structure and the paragraph break.
fieldGuidance.release_notes: The "What's New" text on the update sheet. Match the tone of the English; keep it plain and concise.
